title: stegnogramma pozoi subsp. mollissima
intro: Stegnogramma pozoi subsp. mollissima, commonly known as Soft Shield Fern, is a type of fern native to tropical regions. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health conditions such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Stegnogramma pozoi subsp. mollissima include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which aid in reducing inflammation, lowering fever, and loosening mucus in the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
